Commentary.Commentary: The visitors were impeccable with the ball in the first two sessions of Day 1 but they lost their track in the final session only to come back stronger today morning. The pace duo of Amir and Abbas struck in their respective first overs of the second day and continued to bowl good lines and lengths. Pakistan will now walk out with the bat and will look to play with authority while West Indies will want some early wickets in their kitty. Join us in a while for the second innings.

West Indies have posted a decent total on the board. After electing to bat, they struggled to start positively. They lost three quick wickets at the top and the visitors were on top. After that, Kieran Powell played a fighting knock but was soon sent back by Mohammad Amir. Roston Chase and Jason Holder were the mainstays and they were the only reason the hosts were able to cross the 300-run mark. The former got onto score his second Test century while the latter also registered a fifty.

OUT! Timber! Yasir Shah bowls a full toss on leg stump, Joseph clears his front leg and looks to swing it over mid-wicket but misses. The ball hits his pad and deflects back to the leg stump. A ball which was there for capitalizing upon but you can't expect much from a tailender. WEST INDIES ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 312!
Joseph camps back and pushes it to point.
Joseph stays back and defends it to short cover.
A bit shortish and spinning away, Joseph plays it to the fielder at point.
Tossed up around off, pushed to covers.
Yasir Shah is called into the attack.
Angling down the leg side, Gabriel fails to clip it through and is rapped on the pads.
Square leg goes back.
A bit short this time around off, Gabriel sways away from the line of the delivery.
Good length delivery around off, Gabriel punches it straight back to the bowler. Abbas cannot stop it and the ball goes towards the fielder at mid off.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Gabriel gets behind the line of the ball and defends it well.
Shannon Gabriel is the last man in.

OUT! Bishoo throws it away! Abbas comes around the wicket and bowls this on a length around off. Bishoo swings hard at it but gets it straight to the fielder at mid on. Yasir Shah makes no mistake and takes a fine overhead catch. He was asked by Misbah to have a bit of rest who wanted to bring someone else into the attack but Abbas wanted to bowl another one. He gets the reward for it. Well bowled Mohammad Abbas! Good field positioning as well as Shah was standing a bit up at mid on.
Fuller delivery outside off, Joseph goes for the drive but fails to make contact.
Another fuller delivery outside off, Joseph drives it uppishly through the cover region for a couple.
Good length delivery outside off, Bishoo cuts it towards the fielder at third man for a single.
Fuller delivery outside off, Bishoo drives it straight to the fielder at covers.
Length delivery outside off, Bishoo defends it towards the fielder at covers.
Fuller delivery into the stumps, Bishoo drives it towards the fielder at mid on.
Good length delivery outside off, Joseph punches it towards the fielder at covers.
Another short delivery outside off, Joseph goes for the hook again but he fails to make any contact.
Short delivery into the body, Joseph goes for the hook but he fails to make contact.
Good length delivery outside off, Joseph punches it towards the fielder at covers.
Length delivery outside off, left alone.
FOUR! Shot of the day! Fuller delivery around off, Joseph leans into the drive and gets it through the mid off region for a boundary. Any top order batsmen will be proud of that.
Bishoo stands his ground and defends it neatly.
Short and wide outside off, Bishoo pushes it towards the fielder at point.
Low full toss into the stumps, Bishoo drives it towards the fielder at mid off.
Short and wide outside off, Bishoo unleashes his punch towards the fielder at point. Shadab Khan misfields and the batsmen run a couple.
The batsman has punched that ball through the offside.

FOUR! Lucky runs! Length delivery outside off, Bishoo tries to defend it. Gets a thick outside edge which flies through the gap between second slip and gully region for a boundary. 300 up for West Indies.
Fuller delivery into the stumps, Joseph clips it through the mid-wicket region from the inside half of his bat. Two runs taken.
Length delivery outside off, Joseph tries to defend it. Gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Short delivery outside off, Joseph goes for the pull but fails to make contact.
Full delivery and swinging in, Joseph pushes it towards the fielder at mid on.
Fuller delivery in the line of the stumps, Joseph clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Angling into the pads, Joseph pushes it towards the fielder at mid on.
Bishoo gets behind the line of the ball and defends it.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR Leg Byes! Off the body! Short delivery into the body, Bishoo tries to fend it away but gets hit on the arm guard. The ball flies over the keeper and races away to the fence.
Length delivery outside off, Bishoo punches it through the extra cover region for another couple.
Into the pads, Bishoo clips it through the square leg region for a brace.

Falls short! Good length delivery angling into the batsman, Bishoo stays in his crease and tries to defend it with soft hands. Gets a thick outside edge which falls just short of the first slip fielder.
Sprayed into the pads, Bishoo clips it through the mid-wicket region. The batsmen run three and Bishoo retains the strike.
Good length delivery outside off, Bishoo goes for the square cut but misses the ball completely.
Comes round the wicket this time, Bishoo drives it towards the fielder at mid off.
Fuller delivery way outside off, Bishoo throws his bat to it but fails to make contact.
Good length delivery outside off, Bishoo flays at it but fails to make contact.
Length delivery outside off, Bishoo stays in his crease and lets it through.
Another play and a miss. Joseph tries to poke at it but he gets beaten. A wicket maiden from Amir.
Good length delivery nipping away, Joseph tries to play in his line but gets beaten by the away movement.
Length delivery outside off, Joseph prods forward and pushes it towards the fielder at mid off.
Alzarri Joseph is the new man in.

OUT! So another one bites the dust! Bowls this one on a length around off, Chase prods forward in defence. Gets a thick outside edge and the ball flies towards the fielder at second slip. Younis Khan takes a sharp catch by getting low. A brilliant knock from Chase comes to an end. And now it is Amir who has also made a mark early on in the second day.
Another length delivery outside off, Chase shoulders his arms to it.
Length delivery angling across, Chase stays in his crease and lets it through.
Mohammad Amir to bowl from the other end.
Bishoo thinks of playing the length ball but thinks otherwise at the last moment.
Fuller delivery outside off, Bishoo drives it towards the fielder at covers.
On a length outside off, Bishoo shuffles across and lets the ball go through to the keeper.
Devendra Bishoo walks out to bat. A short leg also comes in for him. Ahmed Shehzad is the man at that position.

OUT! Just the breakthrough Pakistan needed! Pitches this one on a good length, gets this to swing back in and there is a bit of extra bounce which takes the batsman by surprise. Holder tries to leave it but ends up inside edging it. The ball flies away to the keeper. Ahmed moves to his left and takes a safe catch. The visitors have struck early in the day. Abbas gets his third.
Angling into the stumps, Holder drives it back towards the fielder at mid on.
Good length delivery outside off, nips away after pitching. Holder covers the stumps and shoulders his arms to it.

We are ready to get underway. Roston Chase and Jason Holder will resume their innings. The first hour will be important from the point of view of both the sides. Mohammad Abbas to start the proceedings with the ball today. Two slips in place. Here we go...

On the other hand, the visitors need to deal with some concerns regarding their bowling. Yasir Shah is having discomfort in his back and it is to be seen how he fares today. With still four days to go and Pakistan opting to play without a fifth bowler, it puts much more pressure on their bowlers. With the second new cherry fairly fresh, they will be banking on Amir and Abbas to break this threatening partnership and clean the tail in a jiffy. There is a bit of forecast for rain but lets hope it does not play spoilsport. A gripping day of cricket awaits!

Hello and a warm welcome for Day 2 of the second Test match between West Indies and Pakistan at the Kensington Oval, Barbados. The hosts will be pleased with the way they have come back into the contest. Roston Chase and the skipper, Jason Holder are setting a good example on how to plan an innings. The top order of the home side must take note of it and learn that it requires a lot of patience and determination to come out on top in the longest format of the game. The Windies will look to cross the 350-run mark on a pitch which has something on it for both the seamers and the spinners.
...DAY 2, SESSION 1...

Mohammad Amir was the pick of the bowlers and bowled his heart out. He made good use of the angles and varied his lines and lengths to get rewarded with two wickets. Mohammad Abbas and Shadab Khan were also probing but the latter proved to be a bit expensive on his Test debut. The duo of Chase and Holder have taken the hosts to safe harbours and will look to come out and dominate tomorrow morning. Will Pakistan find an inspiration from somewhere and run through their lower order? An absorbing second day of Test cricket awaits. Join us tomorrow for it at 1000 local (1400 GMT). Till then, goodbye and cheers!

A terrific comeback from West Indies and they have pulled things back in their favour to some extent. They were 166/6 at Tea and things were looking a bit gloomy for them. However, it was Roston Chase who continued to put up a brilliant display with the bat and remains unbeaten on 131. The skipper, Jason Holder proved to be an ideal partner for him and also showed great patience and composure to score an unbeaten fifty. They capitalized on the loose deliveries and kept on putting pressure on the visitors. Yasir Shah had a bit of an issue with his back and wasn't his usual self. Pakistan dearly missed a fifth bowler and Misbah has plenty of problems to ponder upon.
Length delivery outside off at 82 mph, Chase shoulders his arms to it. THAT'S STUMPS ON DAY 1!
So the last ball of the day is coming up. Short square leg comes in place.
Leg bye! Length delivery into the pads, Holder fails to clip it through. Gets rapped on the pads and the ball rolls away towards square leg. The batsmen run a leg bye.
Another back of a length delivery into the batsman, Chase fends it off towards backward square leg for a single.
Dug in short into the batsman, Chase ducks under it.
Fuller delivery outside off, Chase prods forward and defends it.
Fuller delivery outside off, Chase drives it straight towards the fielder at covers.
Tossed up just outside off, Holder lunges forward and lets the ball through to the keeper.
Holder camps forward and drives it back to the bowler.
Quicker one outside off, Holder defends it well off the back foot.
That was a ripper! Tossed up around middle and leg, Holder tries to defend it off the back foot. Gets beaten by the away turn and the ball goes just past his outside edge to the keeper.
Floats this one around off, Holder stays in his crease and defends it well.
Short and wide outside off, Chase punches it through covers for a single.
Yasir Shah comes back into the attack. Can he break this partnership?
Good length delivery outside off, Holder stays in his crease and defends it.
A bit short this time outside off, Holder lets it through to the keeper.

FOUR! Edged! Length delivery outside off, Holder goes for the drive. Gets a thick outside edge to it which luckily passes through the gap between the second slip and the gully fielder. The ball races away to the fence.
FOUR! Lucky runs! Short delivery into the body, Holder goes for the pull. Gets a top edge which flies over the keeper's head for a boundary.
6th Test fifty for Jason Holder.

Fifty! Good length delivery outside off, Holder punches it through the backward point region for a couple. The skipper has supported his partner really well and will want to continue going in a strong manner.
Starts with a length delivery around off, Holder stays in his crease and defends it.
Fuller delivery in the line of the stumps, Holder unleashes his drive but gets a thick inside edge which rockets towards the fine leg region for a single.
Holder stays in his crease and punches it to the off side.
Fuller delivery outside off, Holder drives it straight towards the fielder at mid off.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Holder stays in his crease and clips it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller delivery outside off, Holder drives it down the ground. Misbah covers some ground and dives towards his right from mid off to make a fine stop.
Yorker on off, Chase digs it out back to the bowler.
Good length delivery angling across, Chase lets it through to the keeper.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Length delivery outside off, Chase covers his stumps and makes a brave leave.

Almost a caught and bowled! Bowls it on a length around off and the ball is zipping through. Chase is taken by surprise and he ends it pushing it back aerially towards the right of the bowler but it was quite far for Amir to grab it.
Length delivery outside off, Holder pushes it on the off side and calls for a quick single.
Chase stays in his crease and defends it.
FOUR! Top shot! Short of a length delivery on middle and leg, Chase shuffles a bit and pulls it through the square leg region for a boundary.
FOUR! Shot! Fuller delivery outside off, Chase lunges into the drive and plays it through the cover region for a boundary. Two fielders give it a chase but to no avail.
Angling into the stumps from a length around off, Chase shuffles and tries to clip it on the leg side. Gets an inside edge which goes onto hit above the knee roll.
Good length delivery outside off, Chase covers the stumps and lets it through to the keeper.
Fuller delivery outside off, Chase prods forward and defends it.
Good length delivery outside off, Holder shoulders his arms to it.
Three in a row! Amir comes steaming into the find the edge. Holder goes for a booming drive this time but only manages to connect thin air.
Another play and a miss! Length delivery outside off, Holder hangs his bat to defend but gets beaten by the away movement.
On a length outside off, shoots through after pitching. Holder tries to play inside the line but gets beaten.
Fuller delivery outside off, Holder drives it back to the bowler off the inner half.
Back of a length delivery angling into the body, Chase clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Length delivery outside off, left alone.
Angling into the stumps from a length outside off, Chase nudges it towards square leg for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Chase covers his stumps and lets it through to the keeper.
Fuller delivery outside off, Holder goes for a drive. Gets an inside edge towards the fine leg region for a single.
Good length delivery into the stumps, Holder stays in his crease and defends it.
Starts one with spraying down the leg side, Holder fails to clip through.
Mohammad Abbas to bowl now.
Angling into the pads, Chase clips it through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Good length delivery outside off, Chase shoulders his arms to it.
Angling across from a length outside off, Chase goes for the drive but fails to make contact.
FOUR! Terrific! Fuller delivery around off this time, Chase was ready for this one as he presents it with the full face of the bat. Drives it down the ground through the mid on region for a boundary.

Another delivery curling into the pads from a length around leg. Chase tries to clip it through but he misses. Gets rapped on the thigh pad and the ball flies away to the keeper. The players appeal but the umpire stays put.
100-run stand between Roston Chase and Jason Holder.
Pitches it around middle and leg, curls into the pads. Holder clips it towards fine leg for a single.

Second new ball is available and it has been taken straightaway. The reviews for both the sides also get refreshed. Mohammad Amir will have a go with the new cherry. This partnership is threatening to take the game away from Pakistan. Can the visitors break it and pull things back in their favour?
Eased towards long on for a single.
A bit short outside off, Chase punches it towards long on for a single.
Fuller delivery outside off, Holder pushes it on the off side and scampers across for a single.
Floats this one into the pads, Holder gets behind the ball and defends it.
Full into the pads, Holder blocks it away.
Floats this one around off, Chase punches it through covers for a single. 250 up for West Indies.
Azhar Ali is introduced into the attack.
A bit short around off, Chase punches it towards the cover fielder and calls for a quick single.
Chase gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it beautifully through covers for a brace.
Chase clips it straight to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Fuller delivery into the stumps, Chase blocks it away.
Tossed up outside off, Chase camps back and punches it towards wide mid on. Holder wanted the single but Chase sends him back.
Floated outside off, Chase prods forward and defends it.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Short and wide outside off, Holder smells the loosener and dispatches it through the cover region for a boundary.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Holder camps back and clips it straight towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Top shot! Googly around off, Holder reads it well and hammers that down the ground over the mid off fielder for a boundary.
Chase clips it through the square leg region for a single.
Full toss down the leg side, Chase sweeps it towards the fielder at short fine leg.

The physio is attending to Roston Chase. Stretching his body to relax him. It is hot and humid out there and he has been at the crease since a long time. Second new ball is due in three overs. It has been a really good stand between Chase and Holder. Responsible batting and they have never missed out on scoring opportunities.
Tossed up outside off, Holder dabs it towards the fielder at point.
Fuller outside off, Holder drives it towards covers. Shadab fumbles and the batsmen run a single.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.
Fuller delivery into the stumps, Holder swings his bat to it. Gets a thick inside edge past the keeper for a brace.
Floats this one outside off, Holder lets it through to the keeper.
Holder pulls it towards the fielder at mid on.
Fuller down the leg side, Holder sweeps it towards the short fine leg region. The fielder there dives towards his left and makes a fine stop. Saves three crucial runs for his team.
Short outside leg, Holder camps back and defends it.
Chase clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Tosses this one full around leg, Chase drives it towards long off for a single.
Chase clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Spinning in from outside leg, Chase prods forward and defends it.
Quicker one outside off, Holder tries to defend it but he gets beaten by the away spin.
Roston camps back and punches it towards long on for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Chase pushes it towards the fielder at covers.
Full into the pads, Holder clips it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up around off, Holder covers his stumps and lets it through.
Tossed up outside off, Holder stays in his crease and defends it.
Floated outside off, Chase lets it through to the keeper.
2nd Test century for Roston Chase.

FOUR! There it is! Chase celebrates it in an emphatic manner by removing his helmet and making a cross. Tossed up outside off, Chase drives it through covers for a boundary. It has been a very good knock and he deserves every bit of it. He will look to continue and make it even bigger.
Holder camps back and punches it through covers for a single.
Googly from way outside off, Holder lets it through.
FOUR! Top shot! Fuller outside off, Holder finally gets it through the cover region for a boundary. He has driven this really well.
Clipped towards the mid-wicket region.
Another perfect leg spinner. Tosses this one outside off on a driving length. Chase prods forward in defence but gets beaten by the away spin.
Down the leg side, Chase fails to clip it through and he gets rapped on the pads. Missed out on capitalizing on it. Nervy moments for him and he is still stranded on 99.
Spinning away from around off, Chase gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Flatter through the air this time, Chase prods forward and defends it.
Floats it around off, Chase prods forward and defends it.
Fuller delivery around off, Chase digs it out towards mid on.
Quicker one outside off, Holder gets forward in defence but gets beaten by the away spin.
Wrong 'un outside off, Holder cuts it towards point. Azhar Ali makes a fine stop by diving to his left.
Another floated delivery outside off, Holder drives it again to the cover fielder.
Short and spinning away, Holder spanks it straight to the fielder at covers.
Holder covers his stumps and blocks it well.
Low full toss outside off, Chase eases it down towards mid off for a single.
Time for Drinks!
Fullish on middle, Holder gives himself room and drills it back to Yasir Shah. He picks it up cleanly and mimes a throw at the keeper's end. Aggression from the leggie, good to see.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Floated around off, pushed to covers.
Chase opens the face of the bat and dabs it to covers to steal a single. Moves to 98 with that.
Very full on middle, dug out to extra cover.
Fullish delivery, pushed to mid on for a single.
Full and outside off, carved through covers for two runs.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Fullish on off, pushed to Misbah at extra cover and takes him on. Good running and he makes it home safely.
FOUR! Put away! A half-tracker and Chase pulls it uppishly over mid-wicket. Gets it from the toe end and the ball rolls to the fence. He moves onto 94.
Slow through the air outside off, Chase drives it uppishly past the left of extra cover. Two runs taken.
A touch short on off, spins away. Chase camps back and pushes it back to the bowler.
Floated outside off, eased to covers.
Fullish delivery, milked down to long on for a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
50-run stand between Jason Holder and Roston Chase!
Holder camps back and punches it to Misbah at extra cover. He again misfield and concedes the single.
Stays back to the loopy delivery and plays it with an angled bat towards short third man.
Tossed up on off, defended solidly off the front foot.

Shorter in length and spinning away. Holder pulls it towards mid-wicket where the fielder stops it partially only to deflect it towards Yasir Shah again. A single taken. The ball seems to be following him everywhere.
Jason stays back to the shortish delivery and pushes it to covers.
Fullish on off, blocked solidly down the track.
Slips in the googly, Holder reads it well and defends it with the spin to the leg side.
Yasir Shah has injured himself. He has dived on the ball and has taken a blow on his box. The physio is out there in the middle to treat him.

Chase wrists it towards wide mid on. Yasir Shah ambles across to his right and puts in a dive to stop the ball. While doing so, he rolls over the ball. The impact is near the box region as Shah is down again.
Flatter around off, Chase defends it solidly.
Tossed up outside off, driven through point for a single.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.

On a similar line and length, driven to Misbah at short extra cover who fumbles and parries it behind. The batsmen go for the run. The Pakistani skipper rushes after it but by that time, Holder makes it in safely.
Fullish on off, driven to mid off.
This time Roston defends it with the spin to point.
A touch short around off, punched with ease through covers for a run.
Yasir Shah is called back for a bowl. His fitness is a big concern for Pakistan and that is a reason he is not been given long spells with the ball.
Floated around off, Chase drives it towards Misbah at mid off who stops it partially. Single taken.
Chase lunges forward in defense and does so solidly.
Floated around off, pushed to covers.
Quicker one on middle, Chase keeps it out.
Chase strides forward to the tossed up delivery and defends it solidly.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.

Fullish delivery on off, clipped through mid-wicket for a run. Shah ambles after it and dives to his right to stop the ball. Stretches his back even more and lies down on the ground. He is looking uncomfortable.
Searches for the yorker but sprays it down the leg side, Chase looks to flick it away but misses.
Jason shuffles across and clips it towards wide mid on. Takes on Yasir Shah and completes the single with ease. Shah is looking gingerly out there, he is not his hundred percent.
On a length outside off, Holder defends it tentatively.
Short of a length outside off, tapped towards gully.
Fuller length ball outside off, left comfortably.
Googly outside off, spinning in. Chase reads it and taps it towards point.
Fullish outside off, creamed to sweeper cover for a run.
Holder will be thanking his stars! Floated on off, Holder opts to leave it at the last moment and the ball turns away just enough to miss the off stump by a whisker.
Slow through the air around off, Jason looks to defend it but gets it off the outer half towards point.
Pushed quicker through the air on middle, defended off the front foot.
Fullish on middle, Holder stays leg side of the ball and defends it solidly.
Fullish ball outside off, pushed to covers.
On a length outside off, Chase goes for a full blooded drive but gets an inside edge onto his pads and the ball rolls towards the keeper.
Length delivery outside off, Chase punches it to Azhar Ali at short cover who dives to his right to make a good stop.
On a length and angling away from Chase. He plants his front foot across and lets it go.
This one is wide outside off, Roston doesn't flirt with it.
FOUR! Shot! Short delivery and angling away from Chase. He stands tall and pulls it with authority through wide mid on. Gets the desired result.
Mohammad Amir is back for a bowl.
Chase camps back and punches it to sweeper cover for an easy single.
Floated outside off, Jason drives it towards Misbah at covers who gets a bad bounce and is hit near the box. He has a wry smile about it. A run taken.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Streaky runs! A bit of room on offer as the ball spins away. Holder goes for a booming drive but slices it through point. There are two fielders who give the chase but the ball wins the race.
Fullish on off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Shortish outside off, punched to sweeper cover for a single.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
In the corridor of uncertainty outside off, shaping in. Holder looks to leave it but is late in doing so. The ball hits the face of his bat and rolls towards the keeper.
This one comes back in appreciably. Holder stays back to push it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Good length delivery outside off, Holder stays back and defends it to covers.
Fuller length ball, angling in from outside off. Jason eases it to mid on.
On a length and angling into Chase. He turns it through square leg for a single.
Googly again, Holder picks it up and works it to short mid-wicket.
FOUR! Well played! Slow through the air on middle, spins away a touch. Holder gives himself a bit of room and lofts it over mid off. No one in the deep and he picks up a boundary.
Floated around off, Holder prods forward and defends it with the spin.
Full toss on off, wristed towards mid on for a single.
Chase strides forward to the tossed up delivery and defends it.
Well bowled! Slips in a googly at a quick pace around off, spins in. Chase doesn't read it, shapes to cut it at first but manages to defend it at the end.
In the corridor of uncertainty, holds its line this time. Holder points his bat skywards to allow it through.
Very full and straying on the pads, clipped through square leg for a couple.
On a length around off, Jason shuffles a touch and keeps it out.
Angling into Chase who turns it through mid-wicket for an easy run.
Short and room on offer, Chase cuts it through point for a couple.
On a back of a length and tailing in, Chase shuffles a touch and looks to tuck it across but is hit on the thigh pad. A stifled for an LBW is turned down. The height was always going to be an issue.
That's a jaffa! Tosses it up nicely on off, spins away sharply. Holder prods forward to counter the spin but the ball whizzes past his outside edge.
Fullish delivery, pushed to mid on.

Ouch... that must hurt! Slow through the air outside off, Holder drives it straight to Khan who turns back and takes evasive action. Is hit on the lower back as the ball rolls to the off side. After that, he has a laugh about it.
Floated around off, driven to covers.
Driven towards the mid off region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Flatter delivery outside off, defended off the back foot to covers.
Back of a length outside off, Holder camps back and defends it to the off side.
Fullish delivery outside off, driven to short cover.

That's a peach! Abbas goes wider of the crease and angles in a length delivery outside off, Holder shuffles across, takes a couple of steps down the track and looks to work it across. The ball straightens to beat him all ends up. It was a poor choice of shot as well.
On a fuller length and angling in sharply, Holder defends it off the inner half to mid-wicket.
Short of a length outside off, Holder punches it nicely to covers.
On a length around off, Holder covers the line and defends it nicely.
Almost a chop on! Flatter delivery outside off, Chase shapes for the cut but gets an inside edge that just goes past the off stump and beats the keeper.
Silly point comes in place.
Floated outside off, driven crisply through covers for a run.
Slow through the air outside off, defended to the man at gully this time.
Flatter delivery outside off, punched off the back foot to covers.
Fullish delivery around off, driven back to the bowler.
FOUR! Streaky runs! Tossed up around off, Holder pushes at it but gets a thick outside edge wide of the gully fielder and the ball rolls to the third man fence.
Shadab Khan will continue his spell.
Back of a length delivery outside of, Chase camps back and defends it solidly to the off side.

Nice movement! Gets this one to curve in from the corridor of uncertainty, Roston covers his stumps and allows it through. Abbas shown really good control with the ball, hitting consistent lines and lengths regularly.
Short of a length outside off, punched off the back foot to covers.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Back of a length closer to off stump this time. Chase pushes it off the inner half back to the bowler.
Starts off with a good length delivery outside off, angling in. Defended off the back foot to covers.
Welcome back for the final session of play. Roston Chase and Jason Holder will continue with the bat for West Indies. Mohammad Abbas will start with the ball for Pakistan. Here we go...
...DAY 1, SESSION 3...

Shane Dowrich came in and along with Chase put up a fighting stand of 47 runs but it was eventually ended by Shadab Khan who got his first Test wicket. The latter is batting on 70 and needs to carry on for the home side. He will need support from the lower order who haven't disappointed in the past. Amir was the standout bowler for the visitors once again while Shadab Khan was probing as well. Join us for the final session of the day in a while.

A better session for the hosts but they are still on the back foot at present. Powell and especially Chase kept the scoreboard ticking and put the bad balls away. It was Amir who got a timely breakthrough to send Powell packing. The young Vishaul Singh, failed once again to make his mark.
FOUR BYES! Too quick and wide outside off, Holder lets it through. Sarfraz Ahmed cannot stop it and the ball runs down to the fence for a boundary. THAT'S TEA ON DAY 1!
A loose delivery from Shadab, Holder punches it straight towards covers.
Tossed up outside off, Holder guides it towards the fielder at gully.
Another fuller delivery outside off, Holder drives it straight to the fielder at covers.
Fuller outside off, Holder prods forward and blocks it away.
Short outside off, Holder pushes it towards the fielder at covers.
Chase clips it through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Chase gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Fuller around leg, Chase prods forward and defends it.
Another short delivery and Chase does the same. But this time he finds the fielder at covers.
A bit short around middle and off, Chase uses his crease well and punches it through covers for a couple.
Spinning in from the leg stump, Chase drives it towards the fielder at mid on.
Fuller delivery outside off, Holder drives it towards the fielder at mid off.
Tosses this up outside off, Holder thinks of defending it at first but thinks otherwise at the last moment to let it through.
A classic leg spinner outside off, Holder goes for a drive but he gets beaten totally by the away spin.
Around middle and leg this time, Holder prods forward and defends it.
Floats this one outside off, Holder covers his stumps and lets it through.
Quicker one into the stumps, Holder stays in his crease and defends it well.
Spinning in from outside leg, Chase stays in his crease to block it.
Chase gets behind the line of the ball and defends it well.
Fuller around leg, Chase tries to clip it through the leg side. Gets a leading edge towards the fielder at mid off.
FOUR! Poor delivery! Short delivery coming in from outside leg, Chase camps back and punches it through the wide mid on region for a boundary.
That ball has taken the inside edge onto the pads.
Floats this one in the line of the stumps, Chase pushes it towards the fielder at mid on.
Yasir Shah is back on.
Jason Holder walks out to bat.

OUT! Shadab gets his first Test wicket! Floats this one outside off, Dowrich prods forward in defence. Gets beaten by the away turn as he gets an outside edge on it. The ball flies towards the first slip fielder. Younis Khan is the man there who gobbles it up and helps the youngster land his first wicket. The leggie is excited and why not? It's his first wicket after all.
Short and wide outside off, Chase pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Wrong 'un around off, Chase stays in his crease and defends it.
Tossed up outside off, Chase drives it towards the fielder at covers.
Fuller delivery into the batsman, Chase digs it out towards the fielder at mid off.
Googly pitched outside off, Chase prods forward and defends it.
Comes round the wicket this time, pitches it on a fuller length outside off, Dowrich drives it towards the fielder at mid off.
Short delivery into the body, Dowrich sways away from the line of the ball.
Shane gets behind the line of the delivery to defend it.
Dowrich stays in his crease and guides it towards the second slip fielder who dives to his right to make a fine stop.
Another good length delivery outside off, Dowrich shoulders his arms to it.
Angling away from outside off, Dowrich lets it through to the keeper.
Short delivery outside off, Dowrich cuts it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Lands this one around off, Dowrich lunges forward in defence. Gets totally beaten by the spin and bounce. He is lucky not to edge it.
Dowrich prods forward and blocks it away.
Another fuller delivery, Dowrich drives it towards the fielder at mid on.
Fuller outside off, Dowrich blocks it away.
Played to the point region by the batsman.

NOT OUT! Angling into the pads, Dowrich fails to clips it through on the leg side. Gets rapped on the pads and the ball runs through towards fine leg for a leg bye. The players appeal but the umpire stays put. Amir convinces his captain to go for the review. Misbah obliges and the replays show that it would have missed the leg stump by some margin. Pakistan have wasted a review.
Pakistan take their second review and it is regarding an LBW decision against Shane Dowrich. Seems like it is going down leg to the naked eye.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fuller delivery outside off, Dowrich drives it through the extra cover region for a brace. 150 up for West Indies.
Angling into the pads, Dowrich fails to clip it on the leg side. Gets rapped on the pads.

Good length delivery into the body, Dowrich clips it through the square leg region. The fielder runs in from the deep, picks up the ball and he has a shy at the striker's end as the batsmen go for the second. He hits but the bails stay intact. Replays show that if the bails had fallen, Dowrich would have had to walk back. Unlucky!
Good length delivery outside off, Dowrich stays behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Dowrich clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Fuller into the pads, Dowrich clips it fine past the keeper for a boundary.

Dropped! Low full toss outside off, Dowrich goes for a drive. Gets a thick inside edge which goes onto hit his boots. The ball bounces off it and goes straight to the keeper who cannot gather it. A tough chance goes down.
Dowrich lunges forward and blocks it away.
Tossed this one outside off, Dowrich prods forward and defends it.
Shadab Khan is called back into the attack.
Good length delivery, Chase stays in his crease and blocks it away.
FOUR! Brilliant! Length delivery outside off, Chase leans into the drive and smashes it through the cover region for a boundary.
Good length delivery outside off, Chase dabs it towards the fielder at point.
Fires this one full just outside off, Chase drives it straight towards the fielder at mid off.
Wide outside off on a fuller length, Chase shoulders his arms to it.
Comes from around the wicket, pitches it on a length. Chase prods forward and defends it.
Mohammad Amir is back on.
Fuller into the pads, Dowrich clips it away through the square leg region for a couple.
Fuller delivery outside off, Shane drives it back to the bowler.
Full delivery outside off, the batsman defends it with the full face of the bat.
Length delivery outside off, Dowrich gets behind the line of the ball and punches it towards the fielder at mid off.
On a good length outside off, Dowrich lets it through to the keeper.
Length delivery outside off, Chase punches it through the point region for a single.
Floated outside off, Dowrich prods forward in defence. Gets beaten by the away spin.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Sprayed this one into the pads, Dowrich kneels down and sweeps it powerfully through the fine leg region for a boundary.
Outside off, left alone.
FOUR! Punished! Short delivery this time, Dowrich uses his crease and slams it through the cover region for a boundary.
Top stuff from Yasir Shah! Pitches it in the line of the stumps, the ball turns viciously away from the batsman who tries to defend it. Gets beaten all ends up.
Tossed up in the line of the stumps, Dowrich gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Angling into the batsman, Chase shuffles a bit and pushes it towards mid on.
Chase stays in his crease an defends the length ball outside off neatly.
Angling into the pads, Chase tries to clip it on the leg side. Gets rapped high on his pads and the players appeal for an LBW. The umpire denies as it was going down leg.
Good length delivery outside off, Roston gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
FOUR! Top shot! Length and wide outside off, Chase cashes on the length and drives it powerfully through covers for a boundary.
Length delivery outside off, Chase lunges forward and defends it well on the off side.
Drinks...
Fullish delivery, Dowrich stays leg side of the ball and defends it to covers.
Roston Chase needs to be patient. He can't afford to throw his wicket away after playing so well.
Chase turns this one against the turn to mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up around off, defended to the off side.

Almost a caught and bowled! On a shorter length this time and spinning away from Chase. He is surprised by the extra bounce as he looks to turn it to the leg side. Instead, chips it just over the right of Yasir Shah who is not able to reach it. Always risky to play against the spin and that too when the surface is gripping.
Tossed up around off, defended to the off side.
Stays back and defends it against the spin to the leg side.
FOUR! Slapped! Short and width on offer, Dowrich cashes in on it and slashes it behind point to earn himself another boundary.
Fuller length ball around off, pushed back to the bowler.

On a length and angling into Dowrich. He shuffles across and looks to play it across. Misses to get rapped on the thigh pad. A casual appeal for an LBW is turned down. That was heading down leg and height was also an issue.
Wide! This one is banged in very short, Dowrich ducks under it with ease. Wide signaled for height.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Fullish delivery outside off, pushed to covers.
On a fuller length outside off, Chase goes for the drive but slices it towards backward point. A slight misfield by the fielder allows the single.
This one takes off from the pitch and spins away. Dowrich gets it off the outer half towards short third man.
FOUR! Shot! Half-tracker on leg stump, spinning in. Shane pulls it over mid-wicket and the ball races to the fence.
Flatter delivery, Dowrich is squared up a touch but defends it.
Tossed up around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Outside off, spinning away. Left alone.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Good length delivery outside off, defended off the back foot to covers.
Back of a length outside off, holds its line. Chase lets it go.
Fullish and straying on the pads, clipped to fine leg for a single.
On a length outside off, shaping in. Dowrich camps back and defends it.
Bowls this one wider outside off, Shane doesn't fiddle with it.
Fuller length ball outside off, Dowrich leaves it alone.
Chase strides forward and keeps this one out.
Chase tucks this one against the angle to mid-wicket.
Lands it outside leg, Chase goes for the sweep but is hit on the pads.
Roston stays back to this one and defends it.
Driven towards the mid off region.
3rd Test fifty for Roston Chase.
FOUR! Short delivery, Chase rocks back and pulls it with authority over mid-wicket and the ball races to the fence. Well deserved half century for Roston Chase.
Change of ends for Yasir Shah.
On a good length, Dowrich looks to tuck it across but is hit on the thigh pad. A stifled appeal for an LBW turned down.
This one shapes in appreciably from outside off. Dowrich pushes at it tentatively and it just goes uppishly wide of the short cover fielder.
Shane Dowrich makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! The bowling change has worked! Bowls a good length delivery and slants it across Vishaul Singh. He hangs back and pushes at it tamely. Ends up getting a healthy outside edge that flies towards Younis Khan at second slip. He is sharp as a hawk, bends low and takes it inches above the ground. Khan is a brilliant slip fielder and he proves it again and again. A nothing shot from the young man, he will be gutted with himself.
Singh stays back to the length delivery and defends it.
Fullish delivery around off, Singh covers the line and defends it solidly.
On a good length and slanting across Vishaul. He camps back and pushes it to extra cover.
Another brilliant yorker on off, Singh is alert to it and digs it out to the leg side.
Comes back over the wicket to the southpaw. On a length outside off, Singh hangs back and defends it to covers.
This one swings in appreciably into Chase. He falls over a bit but manages to clip it uppishly through mid-wicket for a single.
On a fuller length and angling in from outside off, Roston covers the line and defends it.
Dug in short this time, Chase  ducks under it.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Waits for this one to turn into him and nudges it to square leg.
Fullish outside off, Singh eases it through covers for a couple.
Singh comes forward again and defends it with the spin on the leg side.
Slow through the air around off, Singh prods forward in defense.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Comes around the wicket and bowls it fullish on middle and leg, clipped through mid on for a single.
Bangs in a short delivery outside off, Singh sways away from the line to evade it. End of a brilliant over from Amir.
Fullish ball around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Vishaul Singh walks out next.

OUT! Good review, Pakistan! Amir steams in hard and bowls an accurate yorker on middle, angling in. Powell falls over and looks to keep it out on the leg side. Misses it completely and is pinged on the front pad. There is a strong appeal from Amir and his teammates but the umpire stays unmoved. Amir looks at his skipper Misbah-ul-Haq and convinces him to take the review. The replays roll in and it looks very close to the naked eye. Time for the Hawk Eye. It shows that it is going to crash into the leg stump. Powell has to walk back after a decent knock. Amir has provided the vital breakthrough. He varies his lines and lengths so intelligently and absolutely foxed the southpaw this time.
Pakistan have taken a review. The umpires have gone upstairs to check on an LBW appeal against Kieran Powell. That seems pretty close.
Back of a length ball on off, defended solidly off the back foot.
FOUR! Whack! Short of a length ball outside off, Powell stands his ground and slaps it behind point for a rocketing boundary. 100 up for West Indies!
Fuller length ball around off, angling in. Powell defends it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Shot! Tossed up on middle and leg, Chase stays leg side of the ball and creams it down the ground. Beats the mid on fielder with ease and whistles away to the fence.
Slow through the air on middle and off, Chase pushes it to mid on.
Shortish outside off, punched to extra cover.
Slow through the air around off, turning away. Driven to short cover. It is good to see Shah alright now. Doesn't look in any kind of discomfort now.
Fullish once again, Roston eases it down to mid on.
Fullish on middle, nudged through mid-wicket for two runs.
Yasir Shah is back into the attack.

That must have shaken him up! Banged in short and it's climbing up on Powell. He can't get out of the way and is hit right on the side of the helmet. The ball deflects to the man at second slip who takes it.
Fuller length outside off, Kieran puts his head down and defends it calmly.
Similar length delivery outside off, Powell hangs back and defends it to covers.
Back of a length angling into Powell. He covers the line and defends it solidly.
Very straight on this occasion, tucked to fine leg for an easy single.
On a length outside off, Roston doesn't flirt with it.

Ouch... that must hurt! Shortish delivery on middle and leg, Powell hits it towards Azhar Ali at short leg who takes evasive action but is hit on the right shoulder. He seems to be in some pain as his teammates come around. Hopefully, he should be fine.
Shortish outside off, punched to sweeper cover for a single.
Floated outside off, spinning away. Left alone watchfully.
Landed on middle, Chase works it to the leg side.
Tossed up on off, Roston comes forward to counter the spin but gets an inside edge to the vacant square leg region. Two runs taken.
Fullish delivery on off, driven to mid on.
Powell shuffles across and looks to flick the fullish delivery but is struck on the thigh pad.
Good length delivery outside off, defended solidly off the back foot to covers.
Slower delivery at 122 clicks around off, Chase looks to defend it tentatively but gets it off the inner half to square leg. Single taken.
Amir comes around the wicket and bowls it on a fullish length around off, Chase mistimes his drive to mid off.
Fullish delivery around off, Roston strides forward and blocks it.
50-run stand between Roston Chase and Kieran Powell!
FOUR! Well played! On a length on leg stump, Chase stays well balanced and clips it beautifully through mid-wicket. Two fielders give the chase but the ball wins the race.
Mohammad Amir is called back into the attack. Two slips and a gully in place.
Chase uses his feet and drives it towards Misbah at short cover. He parries it towards mid off. Single taken. 11 runs off the over.
Fullish on middle, worked past the diving mid-wicket fielder for a single.

FOUR! Tossed up outside off, Powell drives it sweetly through covers and the ball rolls towards the fence. Mohammad Amir hares after it, picks up the ball and looks to push the ball back in play. Instead, steps on the boundary rope. Sloppy work from him.
Short outside off, Chase punches it off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! Poor delivery and it is duly punished! A half-tracker on off, Chase rocks back and dispatches it with authority over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Tossed up on off, pushed back to the bowler.
The players are back out for the post-lunch session. Roston Chase and Kieran Powell will continue with the bat for West Indies. Shadab Khan will start for Pakistan.
...DAY 1, SESSION 2...

Yasir Shah was introduced into the attack and he soon got rewarded by bowling consistent lengths as Hope was the man to be dismissed. The debutant Shadab Khan also stepped up, got quite some purchase due to moisture but the likes of Powell and Chase managed to see out the tricky period. They stitched in a 35-run stand to ensure no more damage was done. Another exciting period of cricket awaits. Join us back for the post-lunch session in a while.

Pakistan will be really happy with their performance in the first session of the game. After being put into bowl, Amir and Abbas were given the responsibility with the new ball. They were breathing fire and gave away nothing to the West Indian batsmen. Brathwaite and Hetmyer got out to some sensational seam bowling while Powell somehow managed to survive it.
Tossed up outside off, spinning in. Powell keeps it out carefully. Things are not looking promising for Shah. He seems to be in discomfort. THAT WILL BE LUNCH ON DAY 1!
Spins this one down the leg side, Powell lets it go.
Floated around off, defended off the front foot.
Stays back to this one and defends it solidly.
Yasir Shah is struggling with his back a bit. The physio stepped down from the pavilion but is waiting by the sidelines.
This time it's is bowled at a quicker pace, Powell stays back and looks to defend it but gets an inside edge onto the thigh pad.
Tossed up outside off, Powell strides forward to defend it but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball rolls towards short fine leg.
Roston camps back and defends it nicely.
Chase shapes for the cut again but the room is not quite there. Gets a bottom edge down the track.
A touch short in length, punched off the back foot to the off side.
Fullish delivery on off, Chase stays leg side of the ball and blocks it.
Quicker delivery around off, spins away sharply. Chase lets it go.
Loopy ball on middle, driven to mid on.
Tossed up around off, eased through covers for a single.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
A touch short in length and quick in pace, Powell camps back and was shaping for the cut. Is cramped for room but manages to keep it out.
Landed on middle and off, wristed to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Fullish on off, defended off the front foot.
FOUR! Tossed up around off, Powell dances down the track and hammers it over Shah's head for a boundary.
Quicker one and googly this time, Chase doesn't read it. However, manages to keep it out to short third man.
Tossed up outside off, cut away to point.

Spinning into Powell. He turns it past the short leg fielder. Chase wants the single and calls for it. Powell is guilty of ball watching but responds. The throw from the fielder is at the bowler's end but he makes it in time.
Landed on middle and leg, Powell defends it on the leg side.
Chase stays back to the shortish delivery and punches it to sweeper cover for a single.

FOUR! Almost a wicket! Tosses it up around off, spinning away. Chase stays deep in his crease and pushes at it. Gets a thick inside edge that goes past the off stump and beats Ahmed too. Rolls to the fence behind.
Shortish and spinning away, Chase punches it off the back foot to mid on for a single.
Turning into Powell. He works it to square leg and takes a run. Thinks about the second but Shadab Khan is quick to reach it.
Fullish on middle, clipped towards mid on. The fielder does well to stop it and keeps it down to a single.
Tossed up delivery, Chase strides forward and defends it solidly.
Chase stays back and punches it to point.
Vicious! Bowls it on a flatter trajectory on middle, spins away sharply. Chase looks to counter it but is beaten all ends up.
Short and wide, Chase chops it to cover for a single.
Fullish this time, wristed to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Shot! A bit short and room on offer, Chase rocks back and slaps it behind point. Gets a boundary under his belt. He is a good player of spin bowling.
Chase defends this one against the spin to the leg side.
Well bowled! Slips in the googly outside off, turns in. Chase stays back and defends it tentatively. The ball just goes behind on the bounce to the keeper.
Shortish outside off, defended with the spin off the back foot.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Roston drives it towards Shah. He dives to his right to make a half-stop and parries it towards mid on. A run taken.

FOUR! Beautiful! Tossed up on middle and leg, Chase stays well balanced and clips it through mid-wicket. Finds the gap and the ball whistles away to the fence. He played that against the spin but did it so well.
Fullish on off, Roston keeps his head down and defends it calmly.
Chase stays back and taps it to point.
Shortish delivery, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
That one gripped! Tosses it up on a length outside off, spins in appreciably with extra bounce. Powell is surpised by it and gets his gloves on it to keep it away safely.
Fullish on off, Powell milks it down to long on for a run and will retain the strike.
Tossed up around off, spinning away. Roston punches it off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
Low full toss on middle, Chase drives it down to mid on again.
Fullish on middle, clipped to mid on.
Shorter in length again, defended off the back foot on the leg side.
Tosses it up nicely on middle, spinning in. Powell goes deep in the crease and turns it past the short leg fielder. A run taken.
Debutant Shadab Khan has been handed the ball now. He was brilliant in the limited overs. Can he replicate the same form?
Quicker and shorter in length on leg stump, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Powell comes down the track but the length is not quite there to go for the big shot. Defends it to the right of the bowler.
Floated outside off, spinning in. Powell looks to defend it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Slow through the air around off, Powell uses his feet and looks to heave it over mid-wicket. Instead, ends up dragging it to the man at mid-wicket.
Tossed up around off, pushed to covers.
Fullish delivery around off, Powell takes a couple of steps down the track and pushes it towards silly mid on. He dives to his right to make a good stop.
The umpires are checking the ball. Seems everything is fine as the umpire throws it back to Yasir Shah.
Short of a length delivery around off, Chase hangs back and taps it towards cover-point.
On a length at 142 clicks outside off, Roston camps back and defends it solidly to covers.
Comes around the wicket and bowls it on a driving length outside off, Chase resists the temptation.
On a good length and slanting across Chase. He points his bat skywards and allows it through.
Back of a length angling away. Dabbed to the point region.
Shortish delivery angling into the body, Powell helps it towards square leg for a run.
Shorter in length and spinning away, Roston goes back and pushes it to mid off. Brilliant over from Shah comes to an end.
Floated outside off, defended off the front foot to silly point.
FOUR! Off the mark with a boundary! Slower through the air around off, Chase stays leg side of the ball and drives it crisply past the diving fielder at covers for a boundary.
Tossed up around off, pushed to mid off.

Close shave! Quicker one just outside off, skids through. Chase stays back and looks to defend it. Does it down the wrong line and the ball whizzes past his inside edge and into the gloves of Ahmed. That missed the off stump by a whisker.
Roston Chase is the next man in.

OUT! Brilliant piece of bowling from Shah and he gets the reward. Tosses it up nicely on middle, spinning away. Hope strides forward and looks to counter the spin. The appreciable away turn foxes him and he gets a faint outside edge. Sarfraz Ahmed behind the stumps reacts quickly and takes a sharp catch. The Pakistanis appeal confidently and up goes the umpire's finger. Shai Hope's struggle comes to an end. Pakistan are right on top here.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Short of a length ball on off, tapped towards point.

On a fuller length around off, angling in. Powell strides forward and defends it solidly to covers. Ian Bishop on air mentions that this is a good way to defend. Allowing the ball to come to you. However, both Brathwaite and Hetmyer were pushing hard at the ball.
Back of a length outside off and a bit of width on offer, Powell places it to the fielder at point.
Gets this one to shape back in from a good length around off, Kieran covers the line and keeps it down the track.
Fullish delivery attacking the stumps, driven towards mid on.
Well played! Powell uses his feet and drives this one crisply past the fielder at silly mid on. Single taken.
Tossed up around off, defended against the spin to covers.
Spinning into Powell. He hangs back and turns it towards Azhar Ali at short leg. It his his right boot but falls down safely beside the pitch on the off side. Ali had no time to react to that one.
Floated around off, Kieran lunges forward in defense.
Shah drags his length back a touch and slides this one towards the pad. Defended off the back foot to mid-wicket.
Tosses this one around off, Powell strides forward and defends it with the spin to mid-wicket.
Fuller length ball outside off, inviting Hope for the drive. He obliges but goes at it with hard hands. Drags it off the inner half to mid on. Good over from Amir.
Back of a length ball on leg stump, Hope hops back and defends it to the leg side.
Gets this one to curve back in. Hope covers the line and keeps it out watchfully. Amir is keeping him guessing by moving the ball on both sides.
Full length ball on off, Shai keeps his head down and defends it calmly.
Similar length delivery on off, turned towards short mid-wicket.
Starts off his second spell with a peach. Comes from wide of the crease and bowls a good length ball on off, shaping away. Hope stays back and pushes at it tentatively but is beaten all ends up.
Mohammad Amir is back for a bowl.

Time for Drinks. An absorbing period of fast bowling from Amir and Abbas. They bowled intelligently and have takes a couple of early wickets. Yasir Shah has right away extracted some zip from the surface. Pressure is on the West Indies batsmen. Let's see how they tackle the second half of the first session.
Into the pads, Powell clips it off his pads for a couple through square leg.
Powell drives this one straight to the fielder at mid off.
Full toss outside off, Hope drives it straight to the fielder at covers who half stops it. The ball ricochets towards the fielder at mid off and the batsmen run a single.
Gully in place now. Asad Shafiq is the man standing at that position.
Floats this one on a shorter length, the ball bounces a bit more after hitting the deck. Hope gets the time to adjust and then pushes it through the gully region for a couple.
Beaten! Floats this one outside off, Hope tries to drive it through covers. Gets beaten by the away spin.
Tossed up in the line of the stumps, Hope prods forward and defends it.
FOUR! Top shot! Fuller delivery outside off, Powell waits for it and drives it through the mid off region for a boundary. Presents the camera with the maker's name.
Length delivery outside off, Powell stays in his crease to defend it.
Fuller delivery outside off, Powell gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Powell stays in his crease and defends it neatly.
Length delivery outside off, Powell stays in his crease and lets the ball through to the keeper.
Length delivery outside off, Powell prods forward and defends it neatly.
Fuller into the stumps, Hope digs it out towards the fielder at covers.
Flights this one outside off, Hope lets it go through to the keeper.
Floated around middle and leg, Hope prods forward and defends it.
Powell pushes it towards mid on for a quick single.
FOUR! Good shot! Comes round the wicket this time, Yasir Shah tosses this one outside off, Powell charges down the track and drags it wide of the mid on fielder for a boundary.
Full toss outside off, Hope drives it through covers for a single.
Time for spin now. Yasir Shah comes into the attack.
Fuller delivery outside off, Powell drives it towards the fielder at extra cover.
Length delivery outside off, Powell guides it towards the fielder at point.
Hope gets off the mark! Angling into the batsman, Hope clips it through the backward square leg region for a single.
Wide! Short delivery outside off, Hope ducks under it. The ball went too high and the umpire signals it as a wide.
Angling into the stumps, Hope stays in his crease and defends it.
Good length around off, Hope defends it towards the fielder at gully off the outer half.
Fuller delivery outside off, Hope lunges forward in defence.
Powell stays in his crease and defends it on the off side.
Length delivery down the leg side, Powell shuffles a bit and tries to clip it fine on the leg side. Misses it completely and the ball goes through. Wasn't that far from the leg stick.
Length delivery angling away from outside off, Powell goes for a drive. Gets it towards the fielder at mid on off the inner half.
Angling into the pads, Powell pushes it towards the fielder at mid on.
Length delivery outside off, nips away a bit. Powell gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Short delivery into the batsman, Powell ducks under it.
Length delivery outside off, Hope lets it through to the keeper.
Good length delivery outside off, Hope stays in his crease and defends it.
Slower delivery outside off, Hope thinks of going for it at first but lets it go through at the last moment.
Length delivery outside off, Hope tries to push it but manages to get it towards the fielder at mid on off the inner half.
Good length delivery outside off, Hope stays in his crease and punches it towards the fielder at covers.
Fuller length delivery shaping away from Powell. He strides forward and pushes it through covers for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Hope prods forward in defence.
Good length delivery around off, Hope gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Another good length delivery just outside off, Hope covers his stumps and lets it through to the keeper.
Angling into the pads, Powell clips it in front of square leg for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Powell shuffles across and lets the ball through to the keeper.
Powell gets behind the line of the ball and defends it.

That was a peach of a delivery! Good length delivery around middle and off, the ball nips away after pitching. Hope stays in his crease and tries to poke at it. Gets beaten and the ball whizzes just past the outside edge.
Four Leg byes! Angling into the pads, Hope fails to clip it through. Gets rapped on the pads and the ball races past the keeper to the fence.
Length delivery outside off, Hope lets it through to the keeper.
Shai Hope strides out to bat.

OUT! Abbas gets into the act as well! Fuller delivery outside off, Hetmyer reaches out to it and goes for a drive. Gets a thick edge to it and the ball travels at a fast pace towards the fielder at third slip. Azhar Ali reacts well and takes a sharp catch to send Hetmyer back to the hut. West Indies have lost two quick wickets.
Another delivery outside off, Hetmyer covers his stumps and lets it through.
Good length delivery outside off, Hetmyer lets it through to the keeper.
Fuller delivery into the pads, Hetmyer clips it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Shimron Hetmyer walks out to bat.

OUT! Amir strikes early! Length delivery and angling away, Brathwaite shuffles across and pushes at it tentatively. Gets an outside edge to it and the ball flies towards the keeper. Sarfraz Ahmed makes no mistake and pouches it with ease. The drop catch does not cost a bit as Amir is quick to draw the first blood of this encounter.
Brathwaite stays in his crease and pushes it towards the fielder at point.

Dropped! Length delivery outside off, Brathwaite tries to drive it on the up. Gets no timing on that one. The ball goes straight to the fielder at short cover. Shehzad dives to his right, gets his hand to it but fails to hold on to it. You need to take these catches and the fielding arrangement was exceptional.
Good length delivery angling away, Brathwaite lets it through to the keeper.
Brathwaite stays in his crease and pushes it towards the fielder at covers.
Length delivery into the pads, Powell stays in his crease and pushes it towards the fielder at mid on. No runs taken.
A fuller delivery outside off, Powell stays undisturbed in his crease.
Sprayed into the pads, Powell shuffles a bit and nudges it through the mid-wicket region for a brace.
Another good length delivery outside off, Powell shoulders his arms to it.
Fuller delivery outside off, Powell drives it straight to the fielder at mid off.

Good length delivery around off, Powell shuffles a bit and tries to defend it. Gets beaten by the inward movement and gets rapped on the thigh pad. A stifled appeal for an LBW by the players is denied. May be the impact was just outside off.
Good length delivery outside off, Brathwaite lets it through to the keeper.

Length delivery outside off, Brathwaite stays in his crease and pushes it down the ground. Amir tries to stop it but he fails to get down on time and the ball races through the mid off region for a couple.
Amir pitches this one a bit short, catches the batsman by surprise. Brathwaite hops a bit and defends it off the gloves towards the fielder at third slip.
Another inswinger into the batsman, Brathwaite stays in his crease and defends it on the leg side.
Good length delivery outside off, Brathwaite stays in his crease and defends it with ease.
Two short mid-wicket fielders in place now.
Curving in from around off on a fullish length, Brathwaite manages to clip it straight to the fielder at short mid-wicket.
Around off on a length, Powell reaches out to the ball and defends it neatly.
Length delivery outside off, Brathwaite pokes it towards covers for a single.
Fuller delivery just around off, Brathwaite lunges forward in defence.
Length delivery outside off, Powell pushes it with soft hands on the off side for a quick single.
Good length delivery angling into the batsman, Brathwaite stays in his crease to defend. The ball finds the inside edge and goes towards the fine leg region for a single.
FOUR! First boundary! Fuller delivery way outside off, Brathwaite reaches out to it and drives it uppishly through the point region for a boundary.
Mohammad Abbas to bowl from the other end.
Length delivery outside off, nipping away. Powell prods forward in defence and gets it towards gully off the outside edge.
Silly mid off in place now.
A length delivery this time, goes in with the angle. Powell uses his crease well to defend it neatly.
Fuller delivery around off, Powell gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Good length delivery, nipping into the batsman, Brathwaite clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Brathwaite stays in his crease and defends the inswinging delivery neatly.

Nearly a chance! Starts with a good length delivery around middle and off, curves back and the batsmen gets surprised by the extra bounce. Kraigg Brathwaite tries to defend it and he gets hit high on his bat and the ball flies just wide of the fielder at short leg.

The players and the umpires come out in the middle. Kraigg Brathwaite and Kieran Powell to open the batting for West Indies. Mohammad Amir to start the proceedings for Pakistan with the new ball. Three slips and a short leg in place. Here we go...

Pakistan skipper, Misbah-ul-Haq says that it definitely looks a bat first wicket. Adds that they can't do anything about the toss. Further adds that they need to do their basics right. Feels that they got some confidence from the last game, just need to do the right things from the last game. Reckons that after bad batting performances in Australia, it was good to bat like that in the first Test. Mentions that they need to cash on in the first innings. Announces that SHADAB KHAN makes his Test debut replacing Wahab Riaz. Says that there is no grass on the pitch, looks very dry. Ends by saying that with the heat, it will definitely help the spinners.

West Indies skipper, Jason Holder says that they will bat first. Reckons that the pitch is a bit dry and it will remain on the slower side for the five days. Mentions that they will need to make runs and work on the first innings total. Feels that there is a lot to play for as the series is still alive and they are quite confident. Ends by saying that they are playing with the same team.
TOSS - WEST INDIES WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO BAT.

On the other hand, this Test presents a big opportunity for the visitors. They have never won a Test series in West Indies but they look in good shape to change history this time around. Their legends, Misbah-ul-Haq and Younis Khan again came to the fore with the bat and will look to continue their good form. This is their last International series and they will look to end it on a happy note. Bowling has always been a strength for the tourists. Mohammad Amir and Yasir Shah shone with the ball in the first game and will once again look to make life difficult for the home side. Can the tourists take an unassailable 2-0 lead or will West Indies make an inspirational fightback and level the series?

Hello and a warm welcome for the second match of the 3-match Test series between West Indies and Pakistan at the Kensington Oval, Barbados. The troubles for the hosts keep on persisting and they need to find a way to show that they can rise to the occasion at the highest level. Their batting looks below par at the moment. Their top order needs to take up the responsibility and set up a solid foundation for the side. On the bowling front, they possess talent but consistency in hitting the right lines and lengths is the need of the hour for them. Jason Holder will be expecting a much more well-rounded performance from his boys and they will be eager to prove their mettle.
